# knr-ops: Logs Bucket + IRSA + Flux Kustomization

## 1. Base manifests — `infra/s3/logs/`

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs # patched per-env (bucketName must be globally unique)
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1 # patched per-env
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-versioning.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-versioning
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops/myapp-component: logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-server-side-encryption.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-sse
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops/myapp-component: logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops/myapp-component: logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-policy.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops/myapp-component: logs
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "DenyInsecureTransport",
            "Effect": "Deny",
            "Principal": "*",
            "Action": "s3:*",
            "Resource": [
              "${bucketArn}",
              "${bucketArn}/*"
            ],
            "Condition": { "Bool": { "aws:SecureTransport": "false" } }
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - bucket-versioning.yaml
  - bucket-server-side-encryption.yaml
  - bucket-public-access-block.yaml
  - bucket-policy.yaml
labels:
  - pairs:
      knr-ops/myapp-component: logs
    includeSelectors: true
```

> `includeSelectors: true` propagates the label into subresources so the `bucketSelector`/`policy` references resolve.

## 2. IRSA role — `infra/iam/irsa-logs/`

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/role.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": { "Federated": "${oidcProviderArn}" },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "${oidcProviderHost}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
              "${oidcProviderHost}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
            }
          }
        }]
      }
    tags:
      knr-ops/component: logs
```

`${oidcProviderArn}` / `${oidcProviderHost}` are injected per-environment in the overlays via `replacements` (each EKS cluster has its own OIDC provider).

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/bucket-rw-policy.yaml`

Least-privilege read/write on the logs bucket only — no wildcards beyond the bucket ARN prefix:

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    description: Read/write access to myapp-logs bucket (IRSA)
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "BucketLevelRead",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "${bucketArn}"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ObjectReadWrite",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject", "s3:AbortMultipartUpload"],
            "Resource": "${bucketArn}/*"
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/role-policy-attachment.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policyArnSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops/myapp-component: logs
    roleSelector:
      matchLabels:
        knr-ops/myapp-component: logs
```

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
  - bucket-rw-policy.yaml
  - role-policy-attachment.yaml
labels:
  - pairs:
      knr-ops/myapp-component: logs
    includeSelectors: true
```

## 3. Environment overlays

### `overlays/dev/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: myapp-dev
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../../infra/iam/irsa-logs
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/bucketName
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
replacements:
  # Inject bucket ARN into the policy
  - source:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
      fieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
    targets:
      - select:
          kind: Policy
          name: myapp-logs-rw
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.forProvider.policy
        options:
          create: true
      - select:
          kind: BucketPolicy
          name: myapp-logs-policy
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.forProvider.policy
        options:
          create: true
  # Inject OIDC provider for IRSA trust
  - source:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: cluster-oidc-dev
      fieldPath: data.providerArn
    targets:
      - select:
          kind: Role
          name: myapp-logs-irsa
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
        options:
          create: true
  - source:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: cluster-oidc-dev
      fieldPath: data.providerHost
    targets:
      - select:
          kind: Role
          name: myapp-logs-irsa
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
        options:
          create: true
```

Plus a small config patch setting `providerConfigRef: dev` on all resources (or set globally via `spec.providerConfigRef.name` default in a shared patch):

```yaml
patches:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.upbound.io
    patch: |
      - op: add
        path: /spec/providerConfigRef/name
        value: dev
  - target:
      group: iam.aws.upbound.io
    patch: |
      - op: add
        path: /spec/providerConfigRef/name
        value: dev
```

### `overlays/prod/logs/kustomization.yaml`

Identical structure with:
- `bucketName: myapp-logs-prod`, `region: us-west-2` (or per prod env spec)
- OIDC source `cluster-oidc-prod`, `providerConfigRef: prod`

## 4. Flux kustomization — `flux/kustomizations.yaml` (append)

The logs bucket reconciles independently of the main infra:

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: infra-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  path: ./overlays/dev/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops            # same source as other kustomizations
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-gpg
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: infra-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  path: ./overlays/prod/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-gpg
```

## 5. Notes on idiomatic choices

- **Selector-based wiring** (`bucketSelector`, `policyArnSelector`) instead of hardcoded names keeps base → overlay composition robust.
- **No secrets in this feature**; SOPS decryption is enabled on the Flux kustomization anyway (consistent with repo pattern) so future sensitive values (e.g., KMS keys) drop in as `kind: Secret` + `sops:` metadata without Flux changes.
- **Dev/prod isolation**: separate Flux Kustomizations per overlay path — reconciling prod never touches dev state, and drift in one doesn't block the other.
- **Least privilege**: the IRSA policy is scoped to the exact bucket ARN and the `system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer` sub — no wildcard actions.
- Terraform-style `policy` heredocs accept the `${var}` substitution done by kustomize `replacements` at build time, so the rendered manifests are fully valid at apply time.
